_comment: Pick ONE of the two configurations below. Delete this comment block before using.
_local: Use this when Maya is running on THE SAME machine as Claude Desktop.
_remote: Use this when Maya is running on A DIFFERENT machine (e.g. a workstation at the studio).
_remote_prereq: The Maya machine must have MAYA_MCP_HOST=0.0.0.0 set before Maya starts.
_security: Replace <MAYA_MACHINE_IP> with the actual IP or hostname. Only use this inside a studio VPN or with a firewall rule — no auth is built in.
